info.title: SmartLogistics
info.description:
Backend for **SmartLogistics** — TransFleet's supply chain and delivery
orchestration platform.

Authenticate at `POST /api/v1/auth/login`, then use **Authorize** to send the
access token with subsequent requests.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new pair
post.description:
Refresh tokens rotate: the presented token is revoked and replaced.

Replaying an already-rotated token revokes every session for that user, on
the assumption it was stolen.

post.summary: Revoke the current session, or all sessions
post.description: Omit ``refresh_token`` to sign out of every device.

post.description:
Creates in `created` status and **holds the stock**.

The hold is taken in the same transaction, under a row lock, so two requests
for the same units serialise: the first wins and the second is refused with
`insufficient_stock` rather than both being accepted and one failing later.
Holds expire after the configured window if the shipment is never dispatched.

The reference number comes from a Postgres sequence, so concurrent creates
cannot collide.

patch.summary: Move a shipment to the next state
patch.description:
Validated against the state machine, which is the single declaration of
what may follow what. An illegal transition is a 409, never a silent write.

Each role owns part of the lifecycle: warehouse operators mark shipments
ready, couriers drive the custody states, support initiates returns.

post.summary: Release stock holds that have lapsed
post.description:
Expired holds on contended stock are released automatically when someone
tries to reserve it. This sweeps the rest, and is what Celery beat will call
on a schedule in Phase 3 — correctness does not depend on it running.

ShipmentCreate.title: ShipmentCreate
ShipmentCreate.description:
Creates a shipment in ``created`` status.

The destination address is supplied inline rather than by id: an address is
a snapshot of where this parcel was sent, and editing a customer's saved
address must never rewrite a delivered shipment's destination.

ShipmentPriority.title: ShipmentPriority
ShipmentPriority.description:

A standard shipment already late may be raised to CRITICAL; this is what
dispatch prioritisation sorts on.
